name: Hoover's Corn Maze And Pumpkin Patch
description: In 750 Carroll Road, PA, Hoover's Corn Maze And Pumpkin Patch grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a family-run corn maze farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
